components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-primary-content); border: 1px solid var(--color-primary); border-radius: var(--radius-field, 0.25rem); padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-primary), #000 7%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-base-content); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--color-base-content); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-field, 0.25rem); padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-base-200), transparent 50%); }

components.name: Error Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-error-outline { background: transparent; color: var(--color-error); border: 1px solid var(--color-error); border-radius: var(--radius-field, 0.25rem); padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-btn-error-outline:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-error), transparent 90%); }

components.name: Card
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--color-base-100); color: var(--color-base-content); border-radius: var(--radius-box, 0.5rem); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); } .ds-card-body { padding: 1.5rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-card-text { font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5; color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-base-content), transparent 30%); }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-input { background: var(--color-base-100); color: var(--color-base-content); border: 1px solid var(--color-base-300); border-radius: var(--radius-field, 0.25rem); padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; font-size: 1rem; width: 100%; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--color-base-content); outline: none; }

components.name: Select
components.css: .ds-select { background: var(--color-base-100); color: var(--color-base-content); border: 1px solid var(--color-base-300); border-radius: var(--radius-field, 0.25rem); padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; font-size: 1rem; width: 100%; } .ds-select:focus { border-color: var(--color-base-content); outline: none; }

components.name: Badge Primary
components.css: .ds-badge-primary { background: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-primary-content); border-radius: var(--radius-selector, 0.5rem); padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; display: inline-block; }

components.name: Badge Neutral
components.css: .ds-badge-neutral { background: var(--color-neutral); color: var(--color-neutral-content); border-radius: var(--radius-selector, 0.5rem); padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; display: inline-block; }

components.name: Alert Success
components.html: Saved.
components.css: .ds-alert-success { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-success), transparent 92%); color: var(--color-success); border: 1px solid var(--color-success); border-radius: var(--radius-box, 0.5rem); padding: 0.75rem 1rem; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-alert-icon { width: 1.25rem; height: 1.25rem; flex-shrink: 0; stroke: currentColor; }

narrative.overview: This system is deliberately unbranded: it ships daisyUI's default light and dark themes with no custom palette, no custom font, and no bespoke component styling. The visual identity is the framework's defaults, because the project is a learning codebase and clarity of structure matters more than a distinctive look. Density is moderate and utilitarian: cards on a base-200 page background, 0.5rem box radius, 0.25rem field radius, and Tailwind's default 0.25rem spacing unit. Dark mode follows prefers-color-scheme and swaps the base surfaces to deep slate while keeping the same accent hues. The only custom CSS is the sidebar drawer animation and the top navigation progress bar.
keyCharacteristics: daisyUI default light theme on white surfaces; dark theme on deep slate surfaces.
Single system-font stack; no web font is loaded.
Flat by default: elevation appears only on cards and the sticky navbar.
Accent (primary indigo) used sparingly on primary actions and active states.
0.5rem box radius / 0.25rem field radius; 0.5rem selector radius.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Primary indigo is reserved for the single primary action per surface; supporting actions use ghost or outline variants. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Native Face Rule
rules.body: No custom web font is loaded; hierarchy is carried by size and weight alone, so the UI matches the visitor's OS.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; a shadow appears only on cards and the sticky navbar. Hover and focus change color, never elevation.

dos: Do use daisyUI semantic classes (btn, card, input, badge) rather than hand-rolled components.
Do keep one primary button per form; use ghost/outline for the rest.
Do use base-200/50 for hover backgrounds.
Do keep the sidebar collapsed-state tooltips (data-tip) in sync with icons.
Do support both light and dark via prefers-color-scheme.
donts: Don't introduce a custom color outside the daisyUI theme without updating this file.
Don't load a web font; the system stack is the design.
Don't add shadows to hover or focus states.
Don't widen table columns with content; use fixed layout with truncation and tooltips.
Don't remove the fake-latency behavior in production without checking the loading states.
